title: Quiz 2 — Properties of Light & Sound
revision: 2026-11 rev2 — 70:30 LOTS:HOTS, balanced choices, in-scope items only

questions.text: What kind of wave is light?
questions.correct: Electromagnetic wave

questions.text: How fast does light travel in a vacuum?
Why can sunlight reach Earth through the vacuum of space?
options: Light needs no medium to travel
Space is filled with thin air
Sunlight is carried by sound waves
questions.correct: Light needs no medium to travel

questions.text: A straw in a glass of water looks bent at the surface. What property of light causes this?
questions.correct: Refraction

questions.text: Fiber-optic cables carry internet data over long distances. Which property keeps the light inside the fiber?
questions.correct: Total internal reflection

questions.text: Which device produces a narrow, intense beam of light of one color?
questions.correct: Laser

questions.text: Why are LEDs called energy-efficient compared with ordinary incandescent bulbs?
options: They turn more energy into light, less into heat
They need no electricity once they are switched on
They give off much brighter ultraviolet rays
They store sunlight during the day for later use
questions.correct: They turn more energy into light, less into heat

questions.text: Doctors use X-rays to see broken bones. Which property makes this possible?
options: X-rays pass through soft tissue but not dense bone
X-rays bounce off the skin and form a mirror image
X-rays are sound waves that echo from the bones
X-rays heat the bones until they begin to glow
questions.correct: X-rays pass through soft tissue but not dense bone

questions.text: A radio station broadcasts at 100 MHz (1 × 10⁸ Hz). Using c = fλ with c = 3 × 10⁸ m/s, what is its wavelength?
questions.correct: 3 m

questions.text: A bank uses a hologram on its ATM cards. What is the MAIN reason for this choice?
options: A hologram is hard to copy, so it prevents fakes
A hologram makes the card more durable in water use
A hologram stores the owner's money balance
A hologram lets the card work without a chip
questions.correct: A hologram is hard to copy, so it prevents fakes

questions.text: What kind of wave is sound?
questions.correct: Mechanical, longitudinal wave

questions.text: Astronauts on the Moon cannot talk to each other without radios. Why?
options: Sound needs a medium, and the Moon has no air
Sound travels too fast on the Moon to hear
The Moon's weak gravity bends all sound waves
Their helmets absorb all the light waves
questions.correct: Sound needs a medium, and the Moon has no air

questions.text: Which property of a sound wave determines its pitch?
questions.correct: Frequency

questions.text: A worker strikes a steel rail 1 km away. A girl with her ear on the rail hears the hit before her friend standing beside her hears it through the air. What BEST explains this?
options: Sound travels faster in solids than in air
Light from the hammer reaches the rail first
The rail makes the sound higher in pitch
Air absorbs sound only near railway tracks
questions.correct: Sound travels faster in solids than in air

questions.text: Why do recording studios cover their walls with foam panels?
options: Foam absorbs sound and reduces echoes
Foam reflects more sound toward the singer
Foam makes the sound travel much faster
Foam raises the pitch of the recorded voice
questions.correct: Foam absorbs sound and reduces echoes

questions.text: Which device uses sound waves above 20,000 Hz to see a baby inside the womb?
questions.correct: Ultrasound scanner

questions.text: What does an amplifier do to a sound signal?
options: Increases its amplitude, making it louder
Increases its speed so it arrives sooner
Raises its frequency so it sounds much higher
Changes it into light for longer travel
questions.correct: Increases its amplitude, making it louder

questions.text: A fishing boat's sonar pulse returns 2.0 s after it was sent. Sound travels 1,500 m/s in sea water. How deep is the water?
A school beside a busy highway wants quieter classrooms. Which plan is MOST effective?
options: Plant thick trees and use sealed, double-glazed windows
Paint the classroom walls with bright, glossy colors
Open all the windows to let the noise escape faster
Install more loudspeakers so all teachers sound louder
questions.correct: Plant thick trees and use sealed, double-glazed windows

questions.text: A student claims, "Ultrasound and X-rays are the same because both are used to see inside the body." Which judgment is BEST?
options: Incorrect — ultrasound is sound, X-rays are EM waves
Correct — both are sound waves at a very high pitch
Incorrect — X-rays travel slower than ultrasound does
questions.correct: Incorrect — ultrasound is sound, X-rays are EM waves
